visualCharacteristics.structure: header row + data rows, optional caption and row headers

contentPattern.structure: One block row per table row, one cell per column. Row 1 = column headers (the top-left header cell may be left empty), following rows = data. With 'row-headers' the first cell of every data row becomes a row header. With 'caption' the paragraph typed directly above the block becomes the table caption. Typical use: Table (striped), or Table (striped, row-headers, caption) for comparison tables

options.label: Caption from the paragraph directly above
